description: This file defines the TVAnim object in the YAHOO.widget namespace, including constants for animation types such as FADE_IN and FADE_OUT, and methods for retrieving animations and validating types.

methods.name: getAnim(type,el,callback)
methods.description: Returns an animation object of the specified type for a given element, with an optional callback.

methods.name: isValid(type)
methods.description: Checks whether a given animation type is defined.
